readMeFirst: Mocked identities for the prototype. Every participant in this system is mocked (the wayfinder map rules authentication out of scope), and this file is the roster the store is seeded from. Names are invented; departments are taken from the synthetic demo catalog in docs/reference/demo-hierarchy.json so the two fixtures agree. A Charge Number Admin's and an Administrator's department is not used for any routing decision (mint and hierarchy administration are not department-scoped); theirs are set to departments no scenario routes an authorization through, so neither ever ends up approving their own request in the seeded history (src/fixtures/authorization-history.ts). The four roles are the cast in CONTEXT.md - Submitter is deliberately absent, because it is a relationship to one authorization rather than a role somebody holds. Roster sized per #92: exactly one Contributor, one Approver per distinct stage the demo's happy path exercises, one Charge Number Admin, and one Administrator - no duplicates to choose between mid-demo. The demo's happy path is company-funded with matching location types, so it skips both gates (Contracts, Global Trade); neither gate has a seeded Approver here as a result - adding one is a small addition if a later demo script needs a gate to fire.
